legend: This tumour is characteristically paucicellular and composed of bland spindle cells set within an abundant myxoid matrix interspersed with prominent vessels.
Medium-sized to large vessels can be seen, with thickened walls. Note the presence of particularly distinct myoid bundles wrapping around vessels of various calibres.
This tumour is characteristically paucicellular and composed of bland spindle cells set within an abundant myxoid matrix interspersed with medium-sized to large vessels.

A Chromosome 12 schematic illustrating the HMGA2 locus and flanking dual-colour FISH probe set. B Break-apart HMGA2 FISH demonstrates the presence of a rearrangement of this locus in tumour interphase nuclei (split red and green signals). C Schematic representation of an HMGA2-YAP1 fusion identified in a case of aggressive angiomyxoma of the vulva, with the junction between exon 3 of HMGA2 and exon 2 of YAP1.
